fixes: Seeking no longer kills the subtitles — the silence gaps in the subtitle track now hold a single space instead of being truly empty, so VLC always lands on a real sample when you skip or tap the timeline. The first line still starts at the right time and the silences stay silent.

The finish no longer sits on one static "Assembling file…" label for ~25–30 seconds — it now shows the mux percentage as it goes ("Assembling file… 45%"), so a long finish reads as moving instead of stuck.
